summary: View monthly net spending by category or parent group as a stacked chart, in one budget and currency.

operations.name: insights
operations.summary: Turn the host's monthly spending totals into a structured chart. Dates and categories with net refunds retain their original signed amounts.

snapshot.description: BudgetSnapshot with category metadata and a selected monthly spending projection. During an initial lifecycle probe spending can be empty.

currency.description: One ISO currency. Values use its exact minor units.

accounts.description: Other BudgetSnapshot account metadata, unused by this hook.

transactions.description: Other BudgetSnapshot transactions, unused by this hook.

categories.description: Current CategorySnapshot records for naming and grouping series.

spending_by.description: Chart grouping selected in the visual interface.

spending.description: Consecutive selected months in chronological order, including months without spending.

uncategorized_cents.description: Posted uncategorized outflows in minor units.

categories.description: Posted on-budget Expense totals in minor units, signed net of categorized refunds.

amount_cents.description: Signed net amount in the snapshot currency's minor units.

output.description: A structured Insight for the selected chart, or an empty tuple during a lifecycle probe.

value.description: Empty because the insight displays a chart.

detail.description: Short description of spending and refund scope.

series.description: One series per active category or group, including Uncategorized and a bounded Other rollup when needed.

id.description: Stable chart series key for color identity.

label.description: Display name. Individual categories are qualified by their parent group.

values.description: One signed integer currency amount for each of the selected months in order.

output.title: Monthly spending
output.detail: Posted on-budget spending by month. Refunds reduce spending in their posting month.

operations.side_effects: Read-only. Builds a chart in memory from the host projection. No writes, persistent settings or provider requests.
operations.permissions: Host-scoped SDK callback for an active Insights plugin. No access to provider credentials or backend handles.
operations.scope: One budget, environment, workspace and currency, with an inclusive selection of up to 24 consecutive calendar months.
errors: Invalid scope, period or projection is rejected by the host.
Invalid chart results or failed callbacks produce a safe report error; other Insights remain available.
operations.retry: Read again by reloading the Insights page or choosing a valid period. No mutation takes place.
operations.availability: WHAB 2.87.0 or later, Monthly spending enabled, and a compatible visual interface.
